verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a public Developer Platform API defined by an OpenAPI 3.1 spec that can be used to generate typed clients. It also publishes endpoint references for quotes and sessions, and documents an API-driven Customer path for KYC plus server-side calls with a forwarded accessToken, so the product can be driven programmatically. The probe found no spec at standard OpenAPI paths, but that is not a contradiction, since the spec may be hosted elsewhere. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, an OpenAPI spec fetchable at a discoverable public URL, and broader endpoint coverage beyond quotes and sessions in the evidence.
